description: The spec declares `$select` with `collectionFormat: csv`, but they convert to lists the protocol sends as repeated query parameters, which Azure AI Search rejects (`Found duplicate query string parameters that are not allowed: '$select'`). Model each as one comma-separated string.

patches.value: Selects which top-level properties to retrieve. Specified as a comma-separated list of JSON property names, or '*' for all properties. The default is all properties. Comma-separated.
